name: Chang Wei
bio: Chang Wei is dated by Giles to the 8th century AD. His poem here is a poem of homesickness.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: Nostalgia
poems.author: Chang Wei
poems.text:
'Tis autumn, and I watch the streams
Which towards my dear home flow;
I span the distance in my dreams,
And wake to deeper woe.
I cannot read to ease my care.
But solace seek in wine,
And think of friends all gathered there —
When will that lot be mine?

poems.title: 同王徵君洞庭有懷 (Tong wang zheng jun dong ting you huai)
poems.author: Chang Wei
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
八月洞庭秋，瀟湘水北流。
還家萬里夢，爲客五更愁。
不用開書帙，偏宜上酒樓。
故人京洛滿，何日復同遊。
